text: Okay tutor. A bit expensive for what you get. Not bad, not great.
He replaced all the old galvanised pipes in the compound in two days as promised. The tenants have not complained about rusty water since. Good value for the size of the job.
Fast, friendly and careful with my plants on the balcony. The flat felt brand new.
Asked a lot of questions at first, but once we agreed on the design he trusted me completely. Great to work for.
He clearly did not know how to fit a pressure pump and kept calling someone on the phone for instructions. The pump makes a terrible noise now. Avoid if you need a pump installed.
Reliable, honest about progress and never pushes for extra sessions just to earn more. Rare quality. We will keep her for as long as she can teach.
Kept adding walls that were not in the quote and got angry when I asked for more money. I ended up doing two extra rooms for free just to keep the peace.
Used a cheaper brand than the one I paid for. I found the empty tins behind the house. He denied it until I showed him the photos.
She is very strict. Some days that helps, some days the kids just shut down.
Blamed me for their daughter's poor school report and told other parents in the estate not to hire me.
Argued over every shilling and insisted I use the cheap pipes he bought himself, which then burst.
Weekly cleaning, two-bedroom flat in Kilimani.
Paid in full. It took a week of reminders, though. Not sure I would take another job from her.
Pleasant young man and clearly trained. He just took very long, and I am not sure the extra socket needed a full day.
Client was around for the whole job.
Mixed the cleaning chemicals and the whole flat smelled of chlorine for hours. My eyes were burning. That is dangerous.
Client changed the bathroom layout twice after we had started and then refused to pay for the extra fittings.
Clear instructions, but very hard to reach on phone when I needed a decision on the pipe route.
Licensed, showed me his EPRA card without being asked, and gave a written quote before touching anything. The new consumer unit is neatly labelled. Very professional.
Did a clean job on the shower drain and was very respectful in the house. I would hire him again.
Helped us pick the colour when we were stuck between two greys, and his suggestion was the right one. Finished a day early as well. Great experience overall.
She works hard and is honest, I have no doubt about that. But she does not follow instructions, and I have to remind her about the same things every week.
The windows were sparkling, I will admit. Everything else, from the floors to the kitchen counters, looked like nobody had been there.
The colour is exactly what we wanted and the walls look good. The skirting boards, however, have paint all along the top edge and he did not come back to clean them.
Gate motor works. Intercom still does not. He says the intercom was not part of the quote, I say it was.
The parents pay on time, but the home is very noisy during lessons and it is hard for the child to concentrate.
He fixed the fault. It took a while.
Avoid. Took money, did nothing.
Did the nursery in a soft yellow before the baby arrived. Low odour paint as requested, and it dried beautifully. Asante!
Fair price. A bit slow.
The client had already moved the furniture and bought all the paint I listed. Paid the balance the same day I finished. Wish all clients were like this.
Wonderful service. Two visits, two new leaks.
Welcoming home, lunch provided, and the payment came through before I reached the stage.
Very thorough with the mattresses and the curtains. Our house smells fresh for the first time in months.
Client paid well. The site was a nightmare though, with no ladder, no light in the ceiling space and a dog that did not like me.
Good client, though his compound had no shade and working under the sun all day was difficult.
Cleaned the house on Monday.
The oven had not been cleaned in two years and I was embarrassed to show it to anyone. Now it looks like it just came out of the box. Highly recommend her for kitchens.
Polite, but he questioned every item on the materials list and went to check prices himself before agreeing. It added a day. We got there in the end.
Perfect.
The bed frame took a week longer than promised because his timber supplier let him down, but he kept me informed and the quality made up for it. Not a single creak.
Built a dog kennel. Dog seems fine with it. Client paid.
He is good with heavy furniture like beds and tables, but the fine detail on my jewellery box was poor.
Installed a pressure pump for us and labelled every valve so we know what is what. Small touch but very helpful.
Did not show up. Did not call. Did not apologise.
Took a deposit for materials and disappeared for a week. Only came back after I threatened to report him.
The wardrobe is functional. Nothing special, nothing wrong.
I was nervous about online lessons for an eight-year-old, but she kept him engaged the whole hour with games and drawings. He learnt his times tables in three weeks.
Rewired the whole servant quarter in a day. Tidy, safe and exactly on budget. He tested every point before leaving.
Used eco-friendly products because my son has asthma. No harsh smell at all. Thank you for being so considerate.
Reasonable price and he finished on time. The finishing is just okay, with some roller marks if you look closely. Fine for the price.

Arrived a bit late because of the rain in Rongai, but the work itself was excellent. The new geyser is installed properly and he tested everything twice before leaving. He also left his number for any follow-up.
Picked the table up from my workshop and only paid half, promising the rest on Friday. That was six weeks ago.
Fault finding and repair on a lighting circuit in Embakasi. Took about two hours.
Started well. After a few weeks she became more relaxed, and the standard dropped. Still acceptable.
The water heater stopped working the following week and he has not come back to check it despite promising.

Honestly I am torn about this one. He is clearly skilled, the shower pressure is the best it has ever been and the new mixer looks great. On the other hand he worked very slowly, spent a lot of time on his phone and the job took four days instead of the two he promised, which meant my family had no bathroom for most of the week. Good result, frustrating experience.
Client paid on time, but she was not home when I came to install the shelves, so I had to come back the next day.
Two of the six downlights stopped working within a week and the dimmer buzzes loudly. He promised to pass by. Still waiting for him to return.
He seemed knowledgeable and talked well, but the water heater switch melted two days later. Talking is not the same as doing.
Did the job. Did not say much. Left.
Good communication from the first call. Sent the location pin, photos of the DB board and a clear list of what was needed. Made my work easy.
Came with his own ladders and drop sheets, started at 7 and washed the brushes outside so there was no mess in the sink. Professional from start to finish.
Okay for a rental. I would not use him for my own house, but for tenants it does the job.
New client. First visit was okay. Will see how it goes.
Showed up two days after the agreed date with no apology. Then left at 1pm each day. A job quoted for three days took nine.
Repeat client. Same house as last year, same colours.
Arrived two hours late, spent half the time on her phone and left the bathroom worse than she found it. Charged full price anyway.
Patient when the varnish needed an extra day to dry. Paid in full and gave me a good tip. I hope to work for her again.
Two bedrooms and the corridor done in a single day, and the edges along the ceiling are razor sharp. No smell by evening either. Very happy with the result.
She pays on time, but she watches everything I do, and she checks every room after I finish.
Kind and patient with the children. Not very strict, though, and sometimes they get away with not finishing their work.
He was friendly with the kids, credit where it is due. The problem is that friendly is all he was, and the lessons were mostly stories about his own school days.
Paid half and went quiet. It has been a month. I will not work for him again.
Sorted out the changeover switch for our generator. Before, we had to run extensions through the window whenever there was a blackout. Now it is one switch. Life changing, honestly.
My daughter likes her. Whether her grades have improved is another matter, and we will see after the end-of-term exams.
Fixed the leaking kitchen sink within an hour and even showed me how to tighten the trap myself next time. Fair price too. Already recommended him to my neighbour.
He broke two tiles while opening the wall. When I asked him to replace them, he said it was not his problem. Avoid.
Paid fairly and quickly, and the instructions were clear.
Terrible. Avoid.
Fantastic electrician. The lights work beautifully as long as nobody uses the microwave.
Honest and polite. Slower than I would like for the hours I pay her.
Installed the instant shower and tested the earthing properly, so no more tingling from the tap. He also showed me the test reading. I feel much safer now.
He watered down the paint to stretch it. The colour is uneven and it started peeling in the bathroom after three weeks. Very dishonest.
Left live wires hanging out of the wall with only masking tape on them. I have children in this house. Completely irresponsible.
Patchy walls, paint on the sockets and skirting, and brush marks you can see from the door. He said it would look better once dry. It did not. I am now paying someone else to redo it.
Long distance from my home. The family is fine.
First job for this client. The water supply was off when I arrived. The work was done the next day.

We had been dealing with a mystery leak under the floor of our Kileleshwa apartment for almost two months and two other plumbers had already given up. Kiprono came with a moisture meter, traced the problem to a cracked joint behind the shower wall, and explained every step before breaking any tiles. He replaced the joint, patched the wall neatly and the bill matched his quote exactly. Highly recommend.
The socket he installed sparked the first time I plugged in the kettle. When I called him he said that is normal. It is not normal.

We hired a home tutor to help our son through his final year of secondary school, at a fee that stretched our budget. For the first month he was excellent, prepared and punctual. Then he started arriving late, leaving early and sending a younger relative in his place without telling us. The relative had no idea what the syllabus was. By the time we realised what was happening, two months of preparation time had been wasted, and he refused to refund anything.
Safe and tidy installation. Not cheap, and not fast.
Good family, but the house is always very dirty after weekends and the pay does not change for the extra work.
Paid on time and gave me directions that were actually correct, which is rare in Syokimau.
He came at 9pm when our gate motor jammed with the car half inside. Fixed in fifteen minutes. Charged a normal rate too, no 'emergency fee' stories.
Nice finish, but it took twice as long as he said it would.
She respects my time. If she needs to cancel she tells me a day before, and she still pays for the slot.
The wardrobe doors do not close properly and one shelf collapsed the first week. When I called he said I put too many clothes on it.
Our main door had swollen in the rains and would not lock. He planed it, rehung it and treated the edges so it will not happen again. Fifteen minutes and done.
Polite family. They often ask me to stay longer than the hour without adjusting the fee.
